name: workerdeck
description: The self-hosted application control plane for Cloudflare.

DASHBOARD_ORIGIN.description: The final HTTPS origin of this WorkerDeck installation, without a trailing path.

CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID.description: Your Cloudflare account ID, shown on the Workers overview page.

CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_NAME.description: The account name WorkerDeck should display in the workspace switcher.

CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN.description: The least-privilege WorkerDeck control-plane token described in docs/installation.md.

CLOUDFLARE_BUILD_TOKEN.description: The dedicated token used only by Cloudflare Workers Builds for application deployments.

ACCESS_TEAM_DOMAIN.description: Your Cloudflare Access team domain, for example example.cloudflareaccess.com.

ACCESS_AUD.description: The Audience tag from the Cloudflare Access application protecting WorkerDeck.

GITHUB_APP_ID.description: The numeric App ID for your self-hosted WorkerDeck GitHub App.

GITHUB_APP_SLUG.description: The URL slug for your WorkerDeck GitHub App.

GITHUB_APP_PRIVATE_KEY.description: The complete PEM private key downloaded from your WorkerDeck GitHub App.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @workerdeck/dashboard && npm run build -w @workerdeck/contracts && npm run build -w @workerdeck/provider && npm run build -w @workerdeck/cli && npm run build -w @workerdeck/control-plane && node scripts/prepare-cloudflare-build.mjs
scripts.check: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build
scripts.deploy: npm run build -w @workerdeck/dashboard && wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote --config wrangler.jsonc && wrangler deploy --config wrangler.jsonc
scripts.deploy:dry-run: npm run build -w @workerdeck/dashboard && wrangler deploy --dry-run --config wrangler.jsonc
